environment.scene: paused Grand Prix with six karts
environment.method: 180 requestAnimationFrame samples per pass; repeated refreshRate order 3, 0, 3, 0 in the same scene

interpretation: Pausing the stadium RenderTargetTexture removed 617 draw calls and about 1.242 million sampled triangles; repeated P50/P95 results were consistent. GPU timer-query values varied substantially between passes and are intentionally excluded from the conclusion. Runtime now enables refreshRate 3 only within 130 world units of the TV wall and uses 0 outside that radius.
limitations: The benchmark is a paused single-scene render-cost comparison, not a moving-race FPS guarantee.
The 130-unit runtime gate is covered by helper regression tests and production compilation; it is not a separate automated distance-teleport integration benchmark.
The full M7 device/performance target remains open.
